lines.trans: Sasha, hi! How are things?
Hi, little cook! Everything is normal.
Oh, ow! How painful!
What happened to you?
I have a sharp pain in my side.
On which side exactly?
Right here, on the right side.
On the right? That could be appendicitis!
Shall I urgently call an ambulance?
No, no need for any ambulance!
Look, I have two tickets!
What? You are just a jerk, Max!
Will you go to the movies with me tonight?
All right, let's go! See you tonight, actor.
